central-tx.why: Launch-footprint Central Texas core (CAPCOG 10) + corridor extension (5) from _decisions/2026-08-09_launch_footprint_counties.md

dallas.why: DFW MSA 13 counties from same launch-footprint decision

houston.why: Houston-The Woodlands-Sugar Land MSA core 9 counties (Harris, Fort Bend, Montgomery, Brazoria, Galveston, Liberty, Waller, Chambers, Austin) — operator L5 sequence includes Houston after Dallas; probe now for data-posture signal

central-tx.rationale: CAPCOG P2.6 found 13 live layers among 42 nulls + 8 already-registered; corridor (Bexar/Comal/Guadalupe/Bell/McLennan) adds municipal GIS cities. Small towns remain PDF/tile-only.

dallas.rationale: DFW mid/large cities commonly publish Zoning MapServer/FeatureServer (Dallas, Plano, Fort Worth, Arlington, Frisco, etc.). Long-tail suburbs and towns often PDF-only. Roster already has some verified URLs.

houston.rationale: City of Houston has no Euclidean zoning (deed-restriction regime) — expect SEARCHED-AND-ABSENT for Houston proper. Fort Bend / Montgomery / Galveston suburbs often have zoning; Harris suburbs mixed. Overall hit rate expected materially below Central TX and Dallas.

method: Cities from texas_roster_v1.json filtered by P2.6 parent_county_fips (spatial join TxGIO City_Boundaries x TIGER counties). No re-derivation.

stagingSeam.note: Stage requires registry entry + ZONING_STAGING_PATH=1 + --apply to neondb only

doNot: Do not take A1 bulk-writer slot
Do not build parallel staging path
Do not leave zoning_gis NULL after probe — SEARCHED-AND-ABSENT or URL
